what_works: Dark canvas with burgundy accent. Confident one-liner ('Drink it good!') in oversized display weight against minimalist negative space — the page feels like a billboard rather than a brochure.
what_does_not_translate: Wine-importer product grids don't map to service businesses; borrow the dark/oxblood palette and oversized assertion, not the catalog structure.
type_observations: Modern sans display at billboard scale, geometric sans body. One type family, two weights — restraint is the design move.
